name: opaque-frontend
description: opaque's landing page and wallet. TypeScript, built with Vite.

scripts.preview:site: npm run build:site && vite preview --outDir dist --port 5174
scripts.build: VITE_NETWORK=mainnet vite build && VITE_NETWORK=testnet vite build --outDir dist/testnet
scripts.build:site: rm -rf dist && VITE_NETWORK=mainnet vite build && rm -f dist/xrpl.html dist/xrpl-connect.html dist/devnet.html dist/vault.html dist/xrpl-stack.json dist/devnet-stack.json && VITE_NETWORK=testnet VITE_XRPL_STACK_URL=https://opaque-xrpl-testnet-production.up.railway.app/xrpl-stack.json VITE_DEVNET_STACK_URL=https://opaque-eth-devnet-production.up.railway.app/devnet-stack.json vite build --outDir dist/testnet && rm -f dist/testnet/xrpl-stack.json dist/testnet/devnet-stack.json dist/testnet/vault.html && VITE_NETWORK=sepolia vite build --outDir dist/sepolia && rm -f dist/sepolia/xrpl.html dist/sepolia/xrpl-connect.html dist/sepolia/devnet.html dist/sepolia/xrpl-stack.json dist/sepolia/devnet-stack.json dist/sepolia/stack.json && vite build site --outDir ../dist && cp vercel.site.json dist/vercel.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build:site && npx --yes vercel@64.5.0 deploy dist --prod --yes --project opaque-xrpl --scope swarnim-raj-s-projects

comment: `npm install && npm run dev` is the whole setup. Vite serves app.html
(Arc) and xrpl.html (XRPL), transpiles TypeScript on the fly and
hot-reloads. /api is proxied to the backend on :8402, so run `npm run api`
in a second terminal when you need it — the UI runs fine without it.
`npm run ext` builds and then assembles extension/dist, the unpacked
Chrome extension. The wallet is written to Manifest V3's rules (no inline
<script>, no onclick=) so one UI ships to both the web and the extension;
extension/build.mjs fails loudly if that ever stops being true.
These dependencies do NOT reach the scanner. frontend/ is a SIBLING of
../src, never a parent, so Node's upward module resolution cannot see this
node_modules from shipped code. Do not introduce workspaces or a root
node_modules — that is exactly what would break it.
vercel.json installs ../backend, ../packages/* and ../graph as well: the
wallet bundles their source, and a bare import there resolves from THAT
directory's node_modules, never this one. vercel.json allows no comments
(its schema refuses unknown keys, and the deploy fails), so this is here.
